test_bare_setup_reconfigure: test that bare hermes setup runs the full reconfigure wizard on an existing install
test_reconfigure_flag_backwards_compat: test that hermes setup --reconfigure behaves the same as bare hermes setup
test_quick_flag_quick_setup: test that hermes setup --quick runs only the quick fill-missing setup flow
test_fresh_install_first_time_flow: test that bare setup on a fresh install runs the first-time setup flow
test_argparse_flags_plumbing: test that reconfigure and quick CLI flags are correctly parsed and passed to run_setup_wizard
